results.title: An anchor or WORM refusal reaching HTTP
results.evidence: 7 anchor and WORM refusal codes are mapped in STATUS — ['anchor_disagreement', 'anchor_unreadable', 'chain_broken', 'nothing_to_anchor', 'worm_overwrite_refused', 'worm_unreadable', 'worm_bad_name'] — and `Routes.guard` catches neither AnchorError nor WormError (it caught neither). Both carry error, detail and remediation, so the taxonomy is half-built: the status map knows these codes and nothing
